_doc: P2-AVA-13: the scanned campus people the v9 pipeline builds (docs/design/human-v9/ASSET-SOURCES.md). Every source is CC BY 4.0, checked on its official Sketchfab page on 2026-11-17, and fetched without a login from the Objaverse 1.0 mirror (Hugging Face allenai/objaverse, which redistributes the creators' CC BY files under their own licence). Heights are what we scale the scan to; sex and age band are how the person reads (apparent, adults only). The files are third-party: they stay in the git-ignored work/ folder and are never committed. QUALITY: none of these pass the P2-AVA-13 source bar (texture >= 4k, source mesh >= ~100k triangles, a face with clear eyes, lips and ears, arms not clamped to the body); they are kept ONLY as pipeline test inputs, and the v9 flag stays off. A fourth candidate (dwsd 'Robert Full Body') was dropped: its vertex colours are blank white.
